infrastructure-level settings (ports, data dir, interfaces), not
per-component tuning.

One of: tcp, ssl, udp. Maps to the eud_handler --ssl/--udp flags for the
primary container. Upstream runs `eud_handler` and `eud_handler --ssl` as
separate services on the same host; use `ssl.enabled` below to get that.

ssl.description:
Additional `eud_handler --ssl` container in the same pod (mTLS CoT
streaming on OTS_SSL_STREAMING_PORT, required for EUD cert auth). The
container waits for the OTS CA material published by the web pod.
ssl.title: ssl

mediamtx.description:
MediaMTX component: upstream installs mediamtx unconditionally for video
streaming (TAK ICU etc.). Runs as a separate Deployment using the
bluenviron/mediamtx image. Its TLS listeners use the OTS CA material
published by the web pod, and stream auth + lifecycle hooks call back into
the OTS API via the web Service.

tag.description:
-ffmpeg variant includes ffmpeg (upstream installs the ffmpeg package
alongside mediamtx on the host).
tag.title: tag

publisherResources.description:
Resources for the initContainer in the web pod that seeds mediamtx.yml
into the OTS data folder.
publisherResources.title: publisherResources

ports.description:
Listener ports mirror the upstream mediamtx.yml. The `api` port is the
control API the OTS backend calls (OTS_MEDIAMTX_API_ADDRESS).
ports.title: ports

the top-level serviceAccount/podSecurityContext/securityContext/imagePullSecrets.
serviceAccountName.title: serviceAccountName

mediamtx.title: mediamtx

persistence.description:
Optional PVC for the OTS data folder (SQLite DB, config.yml, data
packages, certs). Disabled by default for a minimal ephemeral install.
persistence.title: persistence

podSecurityContext.description:
Chart-wide defaults. Each of web/eudHandler/cotParser below can override
serviceAccountName, podSecurityContext, securityContext and
imagePullSecrets individually; an empty override falls back to these
defaults so every deployment has the same level of configurability.

The OpenTAKServer image runs as the `ots` user (UID 1000, GID 1024) and
keeps the venv in /app (mode 0700, owned by ots). These values must match
that user or the containers will fail to exec the OTS binaries.
podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext

postgresql.description:
Bundled PostgreSQL. Enabled by default so a basic install gets a shared
database for all three components without any extra values. Set
postgresql.enabled=false and configure the `database` block above for
external databases (CNPG, MariaDB operator, cloud RDS, etc.).

scripts.description: Upstream installer enables the postgis extension in the ots database.

00-postgis.sh.default:
#!/bin/sh
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d "${POSTGRESQL_DATABASE:-ots}" -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;'
00-postgis.sh.title: 00-postgis.sh

scripts.title: scripts

postgresql.title: postgresql

extra.default:
deprecated_features.permit.transient_nonexcl_queues = true
management.load_definitions = /etc/rabbitmq/definitions/definitions.json
mqtt.listeners.tcp.default = 1883
auth_backends.1 = internal
auth_backends.2 = http
auth_http.http_method = post
auth_http.user_path = http://opentakserver-web:8081/api/rabbitmq/auth
auth_http.vhost_path = http://opentakserver-web:8081/api/rabbitmq/vhost

auth_http.topic_path = http://opentakserver-web:8081/api/rabbitmq/topic

extraVolumes.description:
NOTE: secretName must match the rendered name of the
rabbitmq-definitions Secret ("<release fullname>-rabbitmq-definitions").
If fullnameOverride or a different release name is used, update this.
extraVolumes.title: extraVolumes

plugins.description:
Match the upstream installer's broker setup: MQTT for EUDs on 1883,
with device auth delegated to the OTS API (auth_http -> web service).
The auth_http URLs must point at "<release fullname>-web" on
OTS_LISTENER_PORT; update them if fullnameOverride or a different
release name is used.
plugins.title: plugins

ui.description:
UI component: nginx serving the OpenTAKServer-UI single-page app on
port 80, proxying /api, /Marti and /socket.io to the web service. This
is a separate image (ghcr.io/brian7704/opentakserver-ui), so it does
not share the chart-wide image or the OTS non-root security defaults.

serviceAccountName.description:
Empty/unset serviceAccountName and imagePullSecrets fall back to the
chart-wide defaults. podSecurityContext/securityContext stay empty by
default: stock nginx must run its master process as root.
serviceAccountName.title: serviceAccountName

ui.title: ui

web.description: Web component: the main `opentakserver` binary serving UI + API on 8081.
